description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Template' class in the Opencart System Library, specifically within the Template namespace. It provides methods for managing template paths, rendering templates with data, and compiling templates into PHP files for caching.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class responsible for handling template rendering, path management, and compilation in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace and associated directory path to the internal path mapping for templates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with the provided data, optionally using a custom code override, and returns the resulting HTML string.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a template file into a PHP cached version, stored in the cache directory, to optimize rendering performance.
